title: Enhance Command Flexibility for PR Review
body:
**Bug Description**
When I tried "/review 880" It was not smart enough to attempt to review a pr with that ID. Please expand commands to take additional arguments.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: 677692b8-38ea-4d75-8693-e4a70f98a9b5
author: shadoath
